scenarios.scenario: Caller tries to create an order or checkout while rollout is not cleared
scenarios.rationale: The API returns 503 unless PAYOS_CHECKOUT_ENABLED is exactly true; tracked and ignored env templates set false.

scenarios.scenario: Attacker supplies arbitrary checkout URL or unsigned PayOS response
scenarios.rationale: Response signature is checked before accepting URL, then HTTPS and exact pay.payos.vn host are required.

scenarios.scenario: Attacker replays or tampers with webhook data
scenarios.rationale: Canonical HMAC-SHA256 signature is constant-time compared and event/reference uniqueness is enforced in persistence.

scenarios.scenario: Browser return/cancel attempts to mark an order paid
scenarios.rationale: Return page only polls persisted state; the paid transition exists only in the server-side PayOS webhook RPC.

scenarios.scenario: SePay callback mutates PayOS payment evidence
scenarios.rationale: PayOS uses isolated tables and RPC; original SePay callback route/RPC remain unchanged.

scenarios.scenario: A worker that outlived its lease marks an order synced after reclaim
scenarios.rationale: Each claim gets a fresh UUID lease token; completion and failure RPCs require the current token, clear it on transition, and return false for stale tokens.

scenarios.scenario: A worker secret is accidentally committed to the tracked environment template
scenarios.rationale: The tracked SHEETS_SYNC_WORKER_SECRET value is the short REPLACE_ME placeholder, below the endpoint's 32-character minimum; a test confirms it is rejected. The previously exposed token must be treated as compromised and rotated in the app and scheduler by the owner.
